target: local Apple M4 (G16G), Mac16,10, macOS 26.6.2 (25G82), Metal 4
boundary: public Metal API only; runtime MSL compile of our own carrier/lit17_unpack/lit17_cvt kernels; binary-archive splice of our own hand-assembled AGX programs (MODE A, tools/agx-isa isadb.assemble()) and of field-level splices into our own compiled instructions (MODE B, reused EXP-0089 anchors); owned shared buffers; every case a fresh process; no Apple binary, archive, BO, or command-stream inspection beyond our own compiled/assembled bytes
predecessor_chain: EXP-0086 (liveness bits not inert) -> EXP-0089 (lifecycle model, literal bit17, ctrl field) -> EXP-0099 (bits15/31 inert for addressing+retention in falu2 register-register form) -> EXP-0119 (this experiment: bits15/31 in NEW contexts, per-family field map, bit17 generalization, mechanism discrimination). Renumbered from EXP-0118 mid-dispatch (coordinator directive, no capture occurred under the old number).

capture.hang_candidate_case: h2_srcmod12b_noloop_ctrl_bit2_HANGPROBE (MUST be case index 76, the last case) -- pre-tested in isolation before this contract was frozen (STATUS OK, no hang, PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 0 item 8); a hang during the gated capture is an accepted, first-class possible result, not a defect

raw_schema.00_env.json: environment/provenance receipt (informational git_revision NEVER gated on -- pinned_revision above + authored_*_sha256 are what matters)
raw_schema.01_results.jsonl: GATED, byte-compared-across-runs: one JSON object per case with keys i,name,group,kernel,splices,oracle,notes,status,pipeline_source,out_hex,observed,match -- no nondeterministic field
raw_schema.01_timing.jsonl: NON-GATED sibling: one JSON object per case with keys i,duration_ms,argv,stdout,stderr -- explicitly NOT required to match across runs
raw_schema.02_dispatch.json: run summary: n_cases, status_counts, match_counts, results_sha256, code hashes
raw_schema.STOP.json: written on any pre-capture or capture-time stop; raw/ left absent if pre-capture; ALSO the expected outcome if the hang-candidate case (last) genuinely hangs -- the preceding 76 cases remain valid, flushed, retained data in that event

hypothesis_to_group_map.H3: H3_IBITCOUNT (plus cross-reference to H2_CACHEBYTE_* and H2_DEVSTORE_ADDRMODE as additional bit-17-position families)
hypothesis_to_group_map.H4: H4_MEMOP_INTERVENING, H4_LATERWRITE_RESTORE, H4_REGFILE_VS_FORWARD, H4_BARRIER (control-flow-join persistence NOT re-tested -- already HW-VALIDATED by EXP-0089's if_boundary/loop_boundary, cited not duplicated)

confirm_vs_refute.H1: CONFIRMS bit15/31 inertness (EXP-0099's finding) if field value 67's own-result equals V=30.0 (reads r3) in every new family/context; REFUTES it if 67 reads 0.0 (genuine address bit) in any of them; a third value is a refuter for both.
confirm_vs_refute.H2: per-family: bit0 matching falu2's opflags-bit19 polarity (corrupts a later reader) CONFIRMS the contract generalizes; a null or different-polarity result REFUTES generalization for that specific family.
confirm_vs_refute.H3: CONFIRMS one shared mechanism if ibitcount's bit17 shows the SAME dual corrupt-own+corrupt-later signature as unpack_convert/cvt_i2f; REFUTES it (evidence for several distinct mechanisms sharing a bit position) if the signature differs -- PILOT ALREADY FOUND a third, different signature (unconditional on the tested bit), see PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 2.
confirm_vs_refute.H4_MEMOP: CONFIRMS persistence if the later reader stays corrupted despite an intervening completed memop; REFUTES it (transient/reset-able) if the reader recovers.
confirm_vs_refute.H4_LATERWRITE: CONFIRMS a per-value/per-write-instance suppression model if a fresh rewrite fully restores the later reader; REFUTES it (permanent per-register poison) if the reader stays corrupted despite the rewrite.
confirm_vs_refute.H4_REGFILE: CONFIRMS 'genuinely gone from the register file' if device_store's own read ALSO sees the corruption; CONFIRMS 'not-forwarded-only, still present via another path' if device_store sees the correct, uncorrupted value while the ALU path is corrupted.
confirm_vs_refute.H4_BARRIER: CONFIRMS persistence-across-a-barrier if the later reader stays corrupted after a real threadgroup_barrier; REFUTES it if the barrier resets/recovers the value.

oracle_source: casematrix.py build_cases() -- pure Python, computed independently of any GPU run, using isadb.imm_encode/imm_decode for the minifloat immediate domain (H.imm_value(), independently verified exact fixed points) and the EXP-0090/EXP-M4-13/EXP-M4-14 HW-validated device_load/device_store/ibitcount address formulas. Every non-trivial oracle value in casematrix.py is annotated 'pilot-CONFIRMED' where it was directly observed on real M4 hardware during the informal pre-registration pilot (see PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 0 and PROGRESS.md), or 'EXPLORATORY' (oracle=None, no a-priori prediction) where it was not.
clean_room: OWN-SHADER + HW-PROBE + PUBLIC. Every byte executed is either our own hand-assembled instruction sequence (tools/agx-isa isadb.assemble()), the compiled form of our own carrier/lit17_unpack/lit17_cvt MSL (tools/shdump, lit17_* kernels reused verbatim from EXP-0089's own committed, authored source), or a field-level splice into that compiled output computed via isadb's own assemble()/decode_one(). No Apple binary introspected anywhere.
